description: Plan (not fly) the fastest route to a distant sector (by travel time over all sector connections). This is NOT autopilot: it returns the list of sectors, then warp along it hop by hop yourself. Also shows a faster hyperlane variant if one exists. Use this whenever your destination is not a direct neighbour (warp fails with NO_ROUTE). Read-only: costs no fuel and does not move the ship.

bearer.description: Your SPACE-CORE Bearer token. Only needed if your client cannot send the Authorization header.

dest_sector_id.description: Target sector ID to plan a route to.

name: get_route
title: Plan travel route
